issuer: North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner
title: North Dakota Tax Guideline (Business) — Alcohol Logistics Shippers
text:
ALCOHOL TAX:
ALCOHOL LOGISTICS SHIPPERS GUIDELINE
Brian Kroshus, Tax Commissioner
The North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner is responsible for the administration of North Dakota
Century Code (N.D.C.C.) Title 5 laws relating to the licensing, taxation, and regulation of alcoholic
beverage brewers and wholesalers in North Dakota. An alcohol logistics shipper may apply for a
North Dakota Alcoholic Beverage Logistics Shipper License under N.D.C.C. § 5-01-16.
Licensing
The North Dakota Alcoholic Beverage Logistics Shipper License is an annual license which covers
fulfillment house services provided to a licensed direct shipper. The business must also be a licensed in
their home state.
The first step to becoming a licensed alcoholic beverage logistics shipper is to apply for the Application
for Alcoholic Beverage Logistics Shipper License which is included in the Alcohol License Application at
www.tax.nd.gov/AlcoholLicenseApplication. The following items must be submitted with the completed
application:
• A copy of the permit issued by your state of residence
• A copy of the business’ organizational documents, i.e., articles of organization, LLC operating
agreement, or partnership agreement
• $100.00 annual license fee
North Dakota Alcoholic Beverage Logistics Shipper Licenses are annual licenses with a December 31st
expiration date. The renewal process will be completed through the taxpayer’s North Dakota Taxpayer
Access Point (ND TAP) account, with a notification being sent in November. License renewals must be
submitted to the Office of State Tax Commissioner before December 1st for the licensed premises to
maintain continuous operations.
A North Dakota Alcoholic Beverage Logistics Shipper License may be suspended or revoked, or denied
for renewal, for a violation of any applicable N.D.C.C. Title 5 provision if the licensee engages in any
activity that does not comply with all statutes or regulations pertaining to logistics shippers. A logistics
shipper is entitled to an administrative hearing before its license may be suspended, revoked, or denied
for renewal.
Operating Activities
North Dakota Alcoholic Beverage Carriers are authorized to engage in the following activities as allowed
by N.D.C.C. Title 5:
• Provide warehousing, packaging, distribution, order processing and/or shipment of alcoholic
beverages on behalf of a licensed direct shipper.
• Ship directly to a residence in North Dakota using a licensed alcohol carrier.
• Label all containers shipped with the words “SIGNATURE OF PERSON AGE 21 OR OLDER
REQUIRED FOR DELIVERY”.
Tax Reporting And Record Keeping
Wholesale Excise Tax - North Dakota alcoholic beverage logistic shippers are not subject to
North Dakota wholesale excise tax. When a licensed North Dakota alcoholic beverage logistics shipper
sells alcoholic beverage products to consumers they will remit the wholesale excise tax imposed under
N.D.C.C. § 5-03-07.
North Dakota Office of State Tax Commissioner

Reporting Schedules and Returns – An alcoholic beverage logistics shipper must complete and submit
the following reporting forms to the Office of State Tax Commissioner. The Schedule L must be filed
electronically through ND TAP (www.tax.nd.gov/tap). The forms and instructions are available at
www.tax.nd.gov/AlcoholTax.
Monthly Reports - Schedule L: A monthly report where alcoholic beverage logistics shipper reports
all North Dakota shipments. The Schedule D report due date is the last day of each month, following
the month of sale. Zero reports are required for the Schedule L. This report is required to be filed
electronically through ND TAP (www.tax.nd.gov/tap).
Recordkeeping - An alcoholic beverage logistics shipper must maintain detailed records for all sales to
North Dakota consumers.
Audit
The Office of State Tax Commissioner may at any reasonable time make an examination of the books
of an alcoholic beverage logistics shipper to determine if it has fully complied with all statutes and rules
pertaining to alcoholic beverage logistics shippers.
Contact Information
For more information on North Dakota alcohol taxes, please visit Alcohol Tax at
www.tax.nd.gov/AlcoholTax. If you have questions, please contact our office at alcoholtax@nd.gov or
701-328-2702.
